steps.label: 3409-lab-math-block-toolbar-open-empty
command: (()=>{const d=window.MathFieldDialog.get();if(location.pathname!=='/lab/view/math-demo.donga'||document.activeElement.id!=='mre1'||d.backdrop.style.display!=='none')throw Error('Focused inline editor required');const button=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tox-toolbar button,.tox-toolbar__primary button')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='블록 수식'&&e.getClientRects().length);if(!button)throw Error('Visible Block Math toolbar control unavailable');button.click();return {open:d.backdrop.style.display!=='none',latex:d.mf.value};})()

steps.label: 3417-lab-math-block-insertion-top-visual
command: (async()=>{const p=document.querySelector('.page-wrapper');if(location.pathname!=='/lab/view/math-demo.donga'||window.MathFieldDialog.get().backdrop.style.display!=='none')throw Error('Expected math Lab without dialog');p.scrollTop=0;await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(r)));return {top:p.scrollTop,height:p.clientHeight,total:p.scrollHeight};})()
